caption: The video captures a black SUV with a roof rack and side-mounted snorkel sliding in a wide circle across a flat pale gravel lakebed, its tires carving concentric tracks. A very low camera swings around the vehicle while heavy radial blur and a tilted horizon ease toward a steadier, level frame. The SUV's face rotates from a rear quarter with glowing taillights, through a broadside profile, to a front end with bright yellow headlights, then back to the side and rear. As the orbit continues, a brown dust plume billows from behind the rear wheels and thickens over the open ground. A thin water strip and a distant tree line tilt across the low-sun sky as the viewpoint circles. The vehicle drifts steadily, moving from the right edge toward the center as the camera pulls back and rises. The maneuver remains underway at both cut boundaries, with no clear start or finish shown.
